paper_title: Constraining hidden photons via atomic force microscope measurements and the Plimpton-Lawton experiment
notes: Laboratory (non-DM) constraints on hidden photon kinetic mixing chi from Coulomb-law-type tests. Two observed limits are presented: an AFM/Casimir setup bound (Fig. 6 red, covering roughly m~0.1-10 eV with chi minimum ~10^-1.5) and the Plimpton-Lawton two-shell experiment (Fig. 7 purple, spanning ~1e-11 to 1e2 eV). Reported here is the observed Plimpton-Lawton bound, reconstructed from the paper's Eq. (26) and asymptotic Eqs. (27a,b) using sensitivity gamma=3.3e-10, R*=0.61 m, R=0.76 m. Small-mass branch chi~1.94e-11/m[eV]; large-mass branch chi~0.0504*sqrt(m[eV]); V-shaped with minimum chi~4e-5 near m~5e-7 eV. These are not DM haloscope limits (no local DM density). Projections (black/orange curves) not included. Coupling is kinetic-mixing chi, i.e. DarkPhoton (not B-L).
